messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: metering-aggregator latency spike + token-count divergence detected for hosted-api ingestion. Overages feed showing +30% bump in last 20m. Auto-suppressing noisy alerts and creating thread.

sam: oncall here, grabbing. what markers do we have?

lee: seeing two symptoms: 1) aggregator consumer lag ~45m, 2) delta between ingest tokens and billing-agg > 25%. logs show retries from consumer group 'metering-processor' around 2033456100.

maria: we've had three customer support tickets complaining about overage emails. unsure if actual billing charged yet. billing pipeline flagged anomalies and queued alerts at 2033456200.

alex: any recent deploys to ingestion or aggregator?

hana: not in last 6h. there's a config push to windowing thresholds yesterday. not related but noting.

sam: running quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n metering -o wide` shows pod metering-agg-5b6 failing liveness. restarting it now.

lee: logs from metering-agg-5b6: ```
ERROR ConsumerPollTimeout: timeout waiting for messages
WARN Reconciler: last-offset 1234567, committed-offset 1229999, gap-size 4568
INFO Retrying commit in 30s
```

sam: restart completed. pod back up but lag persisted. triggering manual reprocess of backlog for window 2033455800-2033456200. kick `scripts/reprocess_window.sh 2033455800 2033456200`

alex: I'll check the aggregations job code for commit logic; maybe a bug in offset handling. pulling a small debug build to run locally.

maria: temporary ask from billing: can we pause overage-email notifications until we verify counts? customers are panicking. we can hold emails for 2 hours.

hana: agree. Recommended mitigation: 1) Pause overage-email alerts 2) Flip alert state to info 3) Run reconcile job and produce provisional report for impacted customers.

sam: paused alerts via `./ops/alertctl mute overage-email --duration 2h` (confirmed). also pinned a temporary rule to route metering writes to fallback aggregator for now: `route: metering -> backup-agg`

lee: started background reconcile job (job id reconc-2033456789). progress: 0/120 buckets done. I'll post periodic updates.

billing-bot: Billing pipeline: hold mode ON. Invoices will be queued. Notifying finance and partner ops.

alex: found a suspicious code path: on consumer retry, commit offset calculation uses int32 and overflows on large gaps — adding guard. PR drafted, will hotfix to release branch if reconcile doesn't clear.

maria: sending templated customer message to affected accounts: "We're investigating delayed usage reports and possible overage notifications. Billing will not finalize charges until verification completes." sending now to top 25 impacted.

hana: good. ops checklist: (a) keep alerts muted, (b) continue reconcile until gap <1%, (c) if reconcile fails, rollback windowing config from yesterday and re-run.

lee: reconcile at +30m: 54/120 buckets done, gap down to 12%. background reprocess succeeded for early buckets, failing on 3 heavy customers. collecting per-customer logs at s3://redwood-metering/reconciles/reconc-2033456789/

sam: rehydrated caches and flushed KV store for aggregator (command `redis-cli -n 2 FLUSHDB`) — note: did this while notifying downstream to avoid double-counting.

alex: hotfix PR submitted: `fix/commit-offset-overflow` -> release-hotfix. Requesting fast-track review.

maria: customer support: we got one escalation from enterprise-corp about potential billing overage email. I've escalated to account team, offering provisional credit if needed.

hana: incident severity: S2 (customer-facing but mitigations in progress). keeping incident room open. I'll take incident lead and coordinate postmortem.

lee: reconcile at +1h: 120/120 buckets processed, gap reduced to 0.9%. committing provisional counts to billing staging. will run diff job and produce CSV for finance.

sam: monitoring for regression after hotfix. no new consumer errors in last 10m.

billing-bot: Billing staging reports deltas saved: s3://redwood-metering/reconciles/reconc-2033456789/results.csv. Scheduling finalization hold for 2h.

maria: notifying affected customers of outcome and that billing will be adjusted if necessary. drafting follow-up.

hana: closing notes: cause preliminary: consumer commit offset overflow + pod liveness crash -> backlog -> reconcile delay -> overage alerts. Action items: 1) patch hotfix PR and roll to prod (alex), 2) add-unit-test for offset math (alex), 3) add metric and alarm for offset-gap > 5k (lee), 4) review alerting playbook to auto-hold overage emails (maria/hana), 5) postmortem with timeline in 24h.

sam: handing off to next on-call (lee) for monitoring. I'm done for this shift. :thumbsup:

lee: taking the handoff. will watch for regressions and post if anything else shows up. :eyes:

incidents-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. ticket INC-2033456789 created and linked to postmortem."
